messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered for service="inference-gateway-prod" — 5xx error-rate spike (now 18% over baseline). PD: INC-48291. Auto-page at 2024-06-21T03:28:08Z (thread root)
maya: acked the page, taking on-call. Investigating. :coffee:
maya: quick check — dashboards show 5xx concentrated in prod-usw2, spike started ~03:24 UTC, request volume normal.
raj: pinging logs, looks like a surge of upstream 502s from kvcache-proxy (usw2). I see repeated: "upstream read error: EOF / 502" in proxy logs.
maya: copying sample log lines:
```
2024-06-21T03:25:11Z gateway[req-7f3]: upstream=kvcache-proxy-2usw2 code=502 err="upstream read error: EOF"
2024-06-21T03:25:12Z gateway[req-8a1]: upstream=kvcache-proxy-3usw2 code=502 err="connection reset by peer"
```
maya: running a few quick checks — curl health endpoints for kvcache nodes, some responding 200, two returning 502.
ops-bot: kvcache-proxy-2usw2 flagged as UNHEALTHY by probe (since 03:24:58 UTC). Auto-remediation: restarting sidecar.
raj: restart didn't fully recover — still seeing 502s on a subset. Could be sticky state in fronting LB or connection pool exhaustion.
maya: rolling a temporary routing bypass to send 20% traffic to standby kvcache in eu-west1 to buy time. Initiating route-slice change now.
ops-bot: route change applied: traffic_slice=usw2:80% eu-west1:20% (change id rt-20240621-1).
sara: heads-up — customers on east-coast clusters might see slightly higher latencies while we warm caches in eu-west1. Noting potential SLA impact.
eli: checking autoscale for kvcache-proxy pool — min replicas currently 4 in usw2; we have capacity to spin up +2 immediately.
maya: please scale +2 now, and increase connection pool limits on new instances.
raj: scaling command:
```
kubectl scale deployment kvcache-proxy-usw2 --replicas=6 -n infra-prod
```
raj: also bumping nginx proxy keepalive from 100 to 500 on the new pods (hot patch).
ops-bot: new kvcache-proxy pods are launching (pod ids: kvcache-proxy-6, kvcache-proxy-7). Health probes passing for one, second still initializing.
maya: observing 5xx rate dropping from 18% -> 9% after route change and first pod healthy. 
raj: still some 502s tied to connections from a particular LB instance (lb-3usw2). Can we drain it?
maya: initiating graceful drain on lb-3usw2.
ops-bot: drain started, active connections draining, new connections routed to other LB nodes.
maya: 5xx down to ~3% now. I'll keep PD incident open until fully stable and do a controlled suppression of noisy repeats so we don't autopage again while mitigation continues.
maya: adding temporary PD suppression key with a 30m TTL to suppress duplicate alerts for same symptom. PD note: suppression_id=sup-20240621-a1 ttl=30m.
pagerbot: Note: suppression in place for symptom="inference-gateway:5xx-surge" until 2024-06-21T03:58:08Z. Escalations suppressed.
raj: following up — found an aggressive retry loop in a recent canary of client-side lib that exacerbated connection churn. Opening PR to backoff retries.
maya: action list so far: 1) route-slice to eu-west1 (done), 2) scale kvcache-proxy +2 (done), 3) drain lb-3usw2 (in progress), 4) patch keepalive + connection limits (done on new pods), 5) PR to fix retry loop (in progress).
sara: customer comms — no major outages detected yet, but some requests experienced 5xx or high latency. Recommend a short status update: "We detected transient elevated errors affecting a subset of customers in US-WEST2, mitigation in progress; minimal customer impact expected."
maya: drafting status and will send after we verify stability for 10 more minutes.
ops-bot: lb-3usw2 drain complete. No more 502s attributed to lb-3usw2.
maya: monitoring — 5xx at 0.6% now, trending down to baseline. Logging a quick incident note and will hand off to next on-call for follow-up.
oncall-jamie: thanks, taking over monitoring and postmortem. Please add any remaining notes to INC-48291 before end of shift.
maya: handing off: all active mitigations complete, suppression key in place until 03:58 UTC, route-slice reverted to normal at 03:43 after warmup, final scale down planned in 15m if metrics stay stable.
raj: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/inference-client/pull/1245 (retry backoff).
maya: closing immediate firefight. Will file a follow-up postmortem with timeline, root cause (client retry loop + LB sticky connection exhaustion), and remediation (hardening health checks, PD suppressed thresholds, automated LB draining on conn-exhaust). :white_check_mark: 
pagerbot: PD incident INC-48291 updated to status=resolved (mitigation applied).
oncall-jamie: acknowledging handoff. I'll schedule a 30-min RCA tomorrow and assign owners. Good catch everyone. :thumbsup:
